name: Voogle Route
author: capisoft-lib
releaseNotes: 1.0.1: hides the Voogle Route panel and History while using the in-game computer to play games, including the launcher, pause and game-over screens. Restores their previous visibility on exit and blocks route shortcuts during the session. Requires LIB BA Player Location 1.0.0+ and LIB BA Unified UI 1.0.0+.
